title: Snake Sage Mode
body:
Syntax: sage train snake  |  sage on snake  |  sage off

Description: Sign the permanent Snake contract at its elder in Ryuchi Cave, then reach level 80 and train there to 100% mastery. Adds 10% damage to jutsu beyond Sage Mode's shared 20% damage bonus. All Sage Modes grant 20% damage, +10 accuracy, and 10% less incoming damage. Active upkeep is 12 Chakra every 10 seconds out of combat or 16 Chakra and 8 Stamina per combat round. See 'help sage training' for the mastery process.

Date: 2026-09-27
